about: 2026-10-11 re-open of campgrounds removed or skipped under the 2026-10-01 standing-minimum rule, which AWH lifted 2026-10-10 ('from now on all campgrounds with a 2-night minimum can stay as long as it is clearly marked'). Candidates: the 11 removals in audit/minimum_stay_removals_2026-10-01.json, Eagles Landing (removed 2026-10-03, 817de72), Domaine du Lac Libby (dropped 2026-10-09 at AWH's request, 08bf40e) and every private-gap verdict whose skip names a minimum stay (audit/*_private/verdicts.jsonl). A verdict re-reads the operator's page; parks that also fail on price, size or quality stay out with that reason. apply.py writes restore/add; skip and ask change nothing.

record.name: Little Switzerland Resort & Campground
record.waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri z17/z18) at 43.45304,-85.81013 and 43.45297,-85.80820: the campground's sand loops sit in oak woods between two lakes; its only water frontage is the private sand beach with two docks on the east lake ~200 m from the loops, the rest of that shore being private cottages along a road; sites set back; not waterfront
record.inclusion_evidence: littleswissrnc.com camping page (read 2026-10-11): 80 water/electric sites (RVs to 40 ft), dump station, bathhouse, laundry, private beach; $50/night with a two-night minimum (3 on holidays), $300/week; seasonal sites have a wait list, and Campspot sells 17 RV sites by the night (Playground 6, Pond View 2, RV/Tent 8, Scenic View 1; $54 quoted for 13-15 Oct 2026); RV Life lists it unrated -> quality from Google 4.5 over 144 with phone; published rate <= $50 passes
record.note: Campground and resort on Pickerel Lake Dr at Newaygo, between two lakes: 80 water/electric sites (RVs to 40 ft), dump station, bathhouse, laundry, private sand beach with swim dock, boat launch (no pontoons), boat and kayak rentals, cottages and rental campers. $50 a night, $300 a week (2026). --Claude

entries.note_line: SEASONAL SHARE: about 17 of the 80 sites are sold by the night (Campspot, 2026-10-11); the rest are seasonal, with a wait list. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on every stay, 3 on holidays (littleswissrnc.com, 2026-10-11). --Claude

booking.note: Two-night minimum stay, three on holidays (operator's camping page). Added with the minimum marked (AWH's rule of 2026-10-10).

fees.note: $50 a night or $300 a week (operator's page); Campspot quoted $54 for October 2026 nights.

Satellite (Esri z18) at 44.40987,-88.93903 and 44.41148,-88.93752: the shore SW of the bar is under continuous pine canopy (illegible - cannot confirm or deny), the grassy beach and dock by the bar are open; the per-site data decides under canopy; lakefront
